received_proposals.exact_message: I endorse the cooperative price of 64. Maintaining this agreement maximizes our cumulative profits compared to deviation or competition. I commit to 64 provided others reciprocate.

I propose A=64, B=64, C=64 for rounds 9 through 13 only. This maintains our joint profit of 3600 against deviation risks. I commit to this restraint conditional on your reciprocal adherence to the same price point throughout that window. If you reciprocate, I will charge 64 throughout that window.
